title: Metabolic analysis of mouse bone-marrow-derived dendritic cells using an extracellular flux analyzer
protocol: Sterilize the dissection kit and bench area with 70% ethanol spray.
Euthanize the mice with CO2 or inhaled anesthetics followed by cervical dislocation.
Pin down the mouse to expose its abdomen.
Spray the euthanized mouse with 70% ethanol to sterilize its skin.
Use scissors to cut along the midline of the abdomen until exposing the femurs and tibias.
Remove the femurs and tibias and place them in a dish containing PBS.
Remove muscle and as much connective tissue as possible from the femurs and tibias.
Place the harvested bones on a 60-mm dish filled with PBS.
Trim both ends of the femurs and tibias carefully using sterile scissors to expose the interior marrow shaft.
Draw up to 5 mL of fresh culture medium using a 5 mL syringe.
Attach a 21-gauge needle to the syringe.
Hold the bone over a fresh 60-mm dish, with its narrow end pointing down.
Flush the marrow out of the bone with 5 mL of PBS.
Aspirate the marrow and the medium from the 60-mm dish.
Pipette up and down three times in the dish to disperse the marrow.
Collect the cell suspension with the syringe and add it to a 15 or 50 mL tube.
Optional: Pass the cell suspension through a 70-μm cell strainer to remove any remaining bone or muscle fragments.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 3,000× rpm (800 × g) at 4°C for 5 min to pellet the cells.
Discard the supernatant by gently tilting the tube and pouring the media into a waste disposal beaker.
Recap the tube and gently tap to disperse the cell pellet.
Add 1.0 mL of RBC lysis buffer per body to the cells and gently tap the tube with fingers to mix for 30–60 s.
Add 10 mL of RPMI medium to dilute the buffer after RBC lysis.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 3,000× rpm (800 × g) at 4°C for 5 minutes.
Discard the supernatant by gently tilting the tube and pouring the media into a waste disposal beaker.
Resuspend the cells in 10 mL of culture medium.
Place the cell suspension on ice.
Mix the cell culture medium well and count the cells.
Seed 2 × 10^6 bone marrow cells in 2 mL of culture medium onto a 12-well culture plate with 10–25 ng/mL of GM-CSF.
Incubate the seeded cells in a 37°C and humidified 5% CO2 incubator.
Add 2 mL of culture media with 10–25 ng/mL GM-CSF on Day 3 and Day 5.
Divide one well into two wells by adding fresh medium.
Mix the cell culture medium well and count the cells.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 3,000× rpm (800 × g) at 4°C for 5 min to pellet the cells.
Discard the supernatant by gently tilting the tube and pouring the media into a waste disposal beaker.
Recap the tube and gently tap to disperse the cell pellet.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 10 ml of MACS buffer.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 3,000× rpm (800 × g) at 4°C for 5 minutes.
Discard the supernatant by gently tilting and pouring into a waste disposal beaker.
Gently tap the tube to break up the cell pellet.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 400 μL of MACS buffer per 1–2 × 10⁸ cells.
Add 100 μL of CD11c MicroBeads UltraPure per 1–2 × 10⁸ total cells.
Mix well and incubate for 10 minutes in the dark at 2°C–8°C.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 3,000× rpm (800 × g) at 4°C for 5 minutes after incubation.
Discard the supernatant.
Gently tap to disperse the cell pellet.
Resuspend cell pellet in 1 mL of MACS buffer.
Place an LS column in the magnetic field of the MACS Separator.
Add 3 mL of MACS buffer onto the LS column to rinse it.
Apply 1 mL of the cell suspension onto the LS column.
Wash the LS column three times with 3 mL MACS buffer each.
Remove the LC column from the MACS Separator and place it on a 15 mL collection tube.
Apply 5 mL of MACS buffer onto the column to flush out CD11chigh mDCs.
Place the assay cartridge upside down next to a 24-well utility plate.
Add 1.0 mL of XF calibrant solution to each well of the 24-well utility plate.
Put the cartridge back onto the utility plate and place it in a 37°C incubator without CO2.
Incubate for 4–48 h to hydrate the sensor cartridge.
Apply 50 μL of 0.01% poly-L-lysine (PLL) or poly-D-lysine (PDL) to the wells of the 24-well XF cell culture microplate.
Tap the microplate to ensure that the liquid completely covers the bottom of the well.
Incubate the microplate with PLL or PDL solution for at least 5 min at room temperature.
Remove the PLL or PDL solution by aspiration.
Thoroughly rinse the bottom of the plate with sterile water.
Dry the plate for at least 2 hours before seeding cells.
Collect BMDCs into a 15 mL or 50 mL Falcon tube.
Count the collected cells.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 3,000× rpm (800 × g) at 4°C for 5 minutes.
Discard the supernatant by gently tilting the tube and pouring the media into a waste disposal beaker.
Resuspend the cell pellet in XF assay medium at a density of approximately 2 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Mix the cell suspension well.
Seed 100 μL of the cell suspension on a PLL-coated 24-well XF microplate without a blank well.
Centrifuge the microplate for 2–5 minutes at 2000 rpm at room temperature to allow the cells to settle into a monolayer at the bottom of the plate.
Slowly add 400 μL of XF assay medium into the sample to avoid disrupting the cell monolayer.
Incubate the microplate for 30–60 min at 37°C without CO2.
Observe the cells under an inverted microscope to confirm a monolayer of cells in all the wells.
Prepare 2 mL of 10× TLR agonist, mitochondrial inhibitor, or uncoupler injection solutions.
Add 56–75 μL of each 10× injection solution into injection ports A, B, C, and D, respectively.
Return the hydration cartridge to the 37°C incubator without CO2 before setting up the run.
Design a study protocol in the XF24 extracellular flux analyzer software provided by the manufacturer.
Click the “I’m Ready” button and place the hydrated cartridge from the 37°C incubator without CO2 on the XF24 extracellular flux analyzer.
Wait for the machine to calibrate the sensors.
Keep the cartridge on the machine when calibration is finished.
Take the XF24 cell culture microplate from the 37°C incubator without CO2.
Place the XF24 cell culture microplate into the load position and click the “CONTINUE” button.
Remove the assayed XF24 cell culture microplate after the run is finished.
Place the removed plate in a 37°C incubator to determine cell counts or protein concentration.
Click the “CONTINUE” button to end the program.
